purpose: Teach: 現われる/送れる/盛り上げる/おのずと/歩き回っ/さらい/か所/ソクラテス

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、運動会の日、本気で、絶対、虹が、絶対、現われる、絶対、瞬間、絶対、ありそうだよね
lines.en: Riku, I'm telling you—on sports day, there's absolutely going to be a perfect moment with a rainbow. I'm serious.
lines.style: Bright, energetic opening. Quick rhythm, infectious certainty. Leans forward slightly. The cadence of someone sharing something she genuinely believes in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お前に、本気で、絶対、メッセージ、絶対、送れる、絶対、よう、絶対、新しいアプリ、絶対、入れたぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Honestly, I downloaded this new app so I can actually send you messages without messing up, Sakura.
lines.style: Slightly self-deprecating laugh underneath. Warm and earnest. Picks up speed mid-thought. Playful admission of having tried before.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、本気で、絶対、お前と、絶対、盛り上げる、絶対、ぞ、リク
lines.en: At the cultural festival, I'm going to make sure we really bring it together, Riku. That's a promise.
lines.style: Determined and warm. Emphasis forward on the promise itself. Steady voice without false brightness. She means it completely.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、頑張ってれば、絶対、おのずと、絶対、認められるさ、桜
lines.en: If you genuinely put in the effort, people will recognize it naturally. They will, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Spoken like he's thought about this before. Steady eye-contact level. Not lecturing—defending her future.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、本気で、絶対、駅前を、絶対、歩き回って、絶対、お買い物、絶対、してきたよ、リク
lines.en: Yesterday I actually spent the whole time walking around the station shopping for stuff, Riku. It was great.
lines.style: Animated recounting. Bright tempo. Small pause after 'station' like she's remembering the details. Genuine pleasure in the telling.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験前、本気で、絶対、おさらい、絶対、しっかり、絶対、しようぜ、桜
lines.en: Before the test, we should really do a solid review together. Let's make it count, okay?
lines.style: Straightforward and encouraging. Light, practical tone without being bossy. Natural pace. The rhythm of someone who actually wants to study with you.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、塾を、絶対、二か所、絶対、通ってるんだよね、リク
lines.en: So you're actually going to two different cram schools? I didn't realize you were that serious about it, Riku.
lines.style: Curious, slightly impressed. Asks like she's genuinely discovering something new about him. Warm undertone—not prying, noticing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 倫理の授業で、本気で、絶対、ソクラテス、絶対、習ったよな、桜
lines.en: We learned about Socrates in ethics class the other day. Remember that, Sakura?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. Slower pace. Like he's turning something over in his mind. Trailing softly—not quite a question, more of a quiet recollection.
